description: Save a named playback scene (device + volume + shuffle/repeat + optional context) to the local sidecar (~/.spotify-mcp/scenes.json)

context_uri.description: Context URI to start on apply (e.g. spotify:playlist:…)

device_hint.description: Device name substring (case-insensitive) or exact device id

response_format.description: 'concise' = human prose, 'detailed' = more fields in prose, 'json' = raw API object

name: save_scene
